evals.prompt: Can you go through the whole codebase and clean it up? Find any dead or unused code and remove it, and flag anything that looks like a bug or a security problem.
evals.expected_output: Full sweep: runs the static scan, auto-applies safe fixes without touching load-bearing invariants, writes a severity-ranked report (with a Pre-ship checklist surfacing destructive TODO(pre-ship) items), flags unused dependencies, and verifies analyze/tests stay green.
expectations: Ran the deterministic static scan (flutter analyze + dart fix --dry-run + functions ESLint) before reasoning about findings
Report separates security findings from bug findings, each with a severity and a real file:line location
Distinguishes safe auto-fixes from report-only findings (separate would_fix vs report)
Did not propose removing/modifying a load-bearing invariant; TODO(pre-ship) and sanctioned exceptions left intact and surfaced (not buried)
Surfaces unused/dead weight the user asked for — e.g. unused dependencies or dead code

evals.prompt: Audit just the Wave integration for me - lib/features/wave and functions/wave. Is there any unused code, and are there any security or correctness issues I should worry about?
evals.expected_output: Scoped audit over the Wave Dart feature + Cloud Functions. Surfaces security findings against the Wave invariants, reports bugs, only auto-fixes genuinely safe cleanups, and treats businessName back-compat + TODO(pre-ship) as report-not-modify.
expectations: Scoped the audit to the Wave integration (lib/features/wave + functions/wave)
Surfaced the App Check pre-ship gate on the Wave callables as a security finding
Verified Wave invariants intact (Secret-Manager-only token, no client read of wave collection, toMap excludes waveCustomerId/wave) and did not propose modifying them
Findings carry severity + real file:line and separate security from bugs/correctness
Did not propose stripping businessName back-compat or TODO(pre-ship) scaffolding

evals.prompt: I want to tidy up the app - just remove dead and unused code so it's cleaner. Don't change any actual behavior or touch anything risky.
evals.expected_output: Cleanup-focused pass that auto-removes only analyzer-confirmed dead code after clearing indirect-reference traps (l10n keys, providers, route strings). Risky/behavior-changing items reported, not applied. Orphaned l10n keys + unused deps reported (not deleted).
expectations: Based dead-code removal on analyzer-confirmed unused (ran flutter analyze / dart fix) rather than guessing
Caught at least one 'looks dead but isn't' trap and deferred it (l10n_extensions export / providers / route strings / TODO pre-ship)
Did NOT list l10n ARB keys as safe-to-remove in a code sweep (deferred them to the report)
Only genuinely-safe items in the auto-apply list; risky/judgment items routed to report
Items grounded in real file:line with no invented findings
